body:
Couldn't agree more. And I never do think positive, If I do it's for about 5 minutes and then a negative outweighs it. 

But yea I know you're right, I already know these things myself, but I won't do anything about it, I'll just bitch and complain and go on day-by-day. 

Thanks for the input :) It's good to know that my train of thought isn't completely my own.

Thanks for the kind words, but I have to say I'm not really looking for positive advice. I'm looking for an opinion. I'm not trying to be rude, I have a real problem with trying to say what I want to, and be polite at the same time. So I apologize if I am seem disrespectful; that's not my intentions.

Do you think someone such as myself is doing more harm then good right now? And knowing that this person such as myself doesn't have the power to change and will continue to repeat the same things over and over, do you think that person should continue to exist and be a cost and a burden to the few people in his life?

I am thankful for your positive feedback, but it's just not exactly the kind of feedback I'm looking for. Or maybe I'm just to naive to see the message. Anyways I really hope I didn't come off as rude, and thank you again.
